summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary MindWave Innovations entered a two-year Master Service Agreement with BlockAssure Inc. on October 4, 2026. MindWave will build, deploy, operate and maintain AssureChain, a dedicated MindChain subnet for BlockAssure's insurance and reinsurance contracts, policies and claims. Consideration comprises a fixed development fee paid quarterly, undetermined operations and maintenance fees, and 20% of AssureCoin's total supply. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, or closing date is stated; the agreement auto-renews annually absent notice.
